claims.statement: Rhee first issued the refugee shelter demolition suspension directive on May24
claims.preciseConflict: Original presidential directive dated May14 (大秘指 內24), later newspaper dated May24; no evidence May24 was issue date.
claims.adversarialMethod: Official item-level archival description crosscheck against newspaper chronology and earlier legal records; facsimile still unread.

claims.statement: Rhee May14 order absolutely forbade any later relocation of refugee shelters
claims.preciseConflict: Archive summary says clean temporary dwellings and gradual relocation to designated sites, not permanent unrestricted settlement.
claims.adversarialMethod: Official item-level archival description crosscheck against newspaper chronology and earlier legal records; facsimile still unread.
